author: 1337isnot1337, with OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: An exact cyclic-span transfer algorithm counts the predecessor cyclic nonlinear support witness in polynomial time for fixed k; a gcd-periodic monomial pattern yields a smaller witness-specific transfer and coprime formula. Sparse quadratic tree systems can require Omega(n/log n) cyclic span in every order. No general SAT bound improvement.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size proof
No uniform locality for all sparse queries or greedy candidates
No improved all-input SAT algorithm or alpha
